profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am an enthusiastic programmer; passionate about advancing technology. I am a fast learner, solid leader, and level-minded problem solver. Through experience, I have learned how to fine tune my work to create an optimal product without exceeding time limits. I can work well within a budget (time and money) and I work well with a team or alone. I am not frightened by new or unknown technology and welcome a challenge, assuming adequate time is allowed to learn.

My expertise is in PHP, JavaScript (and JQuery), HTML (XHTML and HTML5), CSS, and MySQL. All of these skills add to my proficient use and deep understanding the Yii Framework - a powerful PHP framework.

Contact me for anything whenever you want. Thank you for reading.
